about: Rows of the M03-T12 handle table, driven through the art board fixture. Read by artboard_smoke.py (Playwright) and artboard_drive.mjs (puppeteer-core). A point expression returns canvas css px; a check returns null or what failed, polled for up to 3 s.
prelude: window.H = { cv: () => document.querySelector('#board'), st: () => ARTBOARD.state(), L: (id) => ARTBOARD.state().layers.find((l) => l.id === id), ids: () => ARTBOARD.state().layers.map((l) => l.id), h: () => UI.FE.handles, mm: (x, y) => { const v = ARTBOARD.state().view; return [v.ox + x * v.scale, v.oy - y * v.scale]; }, tomm: (p) => { const v = ARTBOARD.state().view; return [(p[0] - v.ox) / v.scale, -(p[1] - v.oy) / v.scale]; }, pick: (id) => document.querySelector('[data-pick="' + id + '"]').click(), at: (deg, r) => { const c = UI.FE.handles.centre, a = deg * Math.PI / 180; return [c[0] + r * Math.cos(a), c[1] - r * Math.sin(a)]; }, mid: () => { const k = UI.FE.handles.corners; return [(k[0][0] + k[2][0]) / 2, (k[0][1] + k[2][1]) / 2]; }, s: {}, types: new Set() }; document.querySelector('#board').addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => H.types.add(e.pointerType), true); null

steps.check: (() => { const h = UI.FE.handles; if (!h) return 'no handles for the selected text'; if (!h.bb || h.corners.length !== 4 || !h.top || !h.dot || !h.centre) return 'handles lack bb, corners, top, dot or centre'; const d = Math.hypot(h.dot[0] - h.top[0], h.dot[1] - h.top[1]); return Math.abs(d - 26) > 0.01 ? 'rotate dot ' + d + ' px from the top, want 26' : null; })()

H.st().sel === 'image' && document.querySelector('li.on[data-layer="image"]') ? null : 'click on the image selected ' + H.st().sel + ' and the list shows ' + (document.querySelector('li.on') || {dataset: {}}).dataset.layer
H.st().sel === 'ring' && document.querySelector('li.on[data-layer="ring"]') ? null : 'list pick did not select the ring on the board'

(() => { const L = H.L('text'), a = H.s.a; return L.dx === a.dx && L.dy === a.dy ? 'drag did not move the layer' : (L.dx * 4) % 1 || (L.dy * 4) % 1 ? 'move left the 0.25 mm grid: ' + L.dx + ', ' + L.dy : null; })()
H.L('text').rot === H.s.a.rot ? 'rotate handle did nothing' : null
H.L('text').size === H.s.a.size ? 'scale handle did nothing' : H.L('text').size <= H.s.a.size ? 'outward corner drag shrank the text' : null
H.L('text').rot === 90 ? null : 'drag ending at 93 degrees committed ' + H.L('text').rot + ', want 90'
H.L('text').rot === 45 ? null : 'shift drag ending at 52 degrees committed ' + H.L('text').rot + ', want 45'
H.L('text').rot === 93 ? null : 'alt drag ending at 93 degrees committed ' + H.L('text').rot + ', want 93'

(() => { const d = H.st().drag; return H.L('text').dx !== 0 ? 'dx ' + H.L('text').dx + ' within 0.6 mm of the centre did not snap to 0' : !d || !d.snapped || !d.snapped.x ? 'no centre guide while snapped' : null; })()
H.L('text').dx === 0.25 ? null : 'alt move to 0.3 mm gave dx ' + H.L('text').dx + ', want 0.25'
H.L('text').dy !== H.s.a.dy ? 'shift drag moved the minor axis: dy ' + H.s.a.dy + ' to ' + H.L('text').dy : H.L('text').dx === H.s.a.dx ? 'shift drag did not move the major axis' : null

(() => { const z = H.st().view.zoom, m = H.tomm(H.s.p); return Math.abs(z - 1.1) > 1e-9 ? 'one notch in gave zoom ' + z + ', want 1.1' : Math.hypot(m[0] - H.s.m[0], m[1] - H.s.m[1]) > 0.01 ? 'zoom moved the point under the cursor by ' + Math.hypot(m[0] - H.s.m[0], m[1] - H.s.m[1]) + ' mm' : null; })()
H.st().view.zoom === 1 && H.st().view.panX === 0 ? null : 'double click on an empty board did not reset the view'
H.st().view.panX === 40 && H.st().view.panY === 20 ? null : 'right drag 40, 20 px panned ' + H.st().view.panX + ', ' + H.st().view.panY
H.st().view.panX === 30 ? null : 'middle drag did not pan'
Math.abs(H.L('text').dx - H.s.a.dx - 0.25) < 1e-9 ? null : 'ArrowRight moved dx by ' + (H.L('text').dx - H.s.a.dx) + ', want 0.25'
Math.abs(H.L('text').dx - H.s.a.dx - 5.25) < 1e-9 ? null : 'shift ArrowRight moved dx by ' + (H.L('text').dx - H.s.a.dx - 0.25) + ', want 5'

steps.js: H.pick('text'); H.s.a = H.L('text'); H.s.n = H.ids().length; null

steps.check: (() => { const ids = H.ids(), s = H.st(); if (ids.length !== H.s.n + 1) return 'ctrl D left ' + ids.length + ' layers'; const c = H.L(s.sel); return ids.indexOf(s.sel) !== ids.indexOf('text') + 1 ? 'duplicate not directly above its source' : c.dx !== H.s.a.dx + 2 || c.dy !== H.s.a.dy - 2 ? 'duplicate not offset 2 mm right and down' : c.text !== H.s.a.text ? 'duplicate text differs' : null; })()
H.ids().length === H.s.n - 1 && !H.ids().includes(H.s.d) ? null : 'Delete did not remove the selected layer'
H.ids().includes('image') ? 'Backspace did not remove the image' : H.st().sel !== null ? 'selection kept after delete' : null
H.ids().indexOf('ring') === H.s.i + 1 ? null : '] did not raise the ring'
H.ids().indexOf('ring') === H.s.i ? null : '[ did not lower the ring'

steps.js: (() => { H.s.n = H.ids().length; /* a synthetic DragEvent keeps whole px only */ const cv = H.cv(), r = cv.getBoundingClientRect(), cx = Math.round(r.left + r.width * 0.3), cy = Math.round(r.top + r.height * 0.7), p = [cx - r.left, cy - r.top]; H.s.m = H.tomm(p); const c = new OffscreenCanvas(32, 32), g = c.getContext('2d'); g.fillRect(4, 4, 24, 24); c.convertToBlob({ type: 'image/png' }).then((blob) => { const dt = new DataTransfer(); dt.items.add(new File([blob], 'drop.png', { type: 'image/png' })); const o = { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, clientX: cx, clientY: cy, dataTransfer: dt }; cv.dispatchEvent(new DragEvent('dragover', o)); cv.dispatchEvent(new DragEvent('drop', o)); }); return null; })()

steps.check: (() => { if (H.ids().length !== H.s.n + 1) return 'drop added no layer'; const s = H.st(), L = H.L(s.sel); if (!L || L.kind !== 'image') return 'the dropped image is not selected'; const e = Math.hypot(L.dx - H.s.m[0], L.dy - H.s.m[1]); return e > 0.01 ? 'image landed ' + e + ' mm from the cursor at ' + JSON.stringify(H.s.m) + ', view ' + JSON.stringify(s.view) + ', canvas ' + JSON.stringify(H.cv().getBoundingClientRect()) : null; })()
document.activeElement && document.activeElement.dataset.text === 'text' ? null : 'double click on text did not focus its field'

(() => { const L = H.L('arc'); return Math.abs(L.arcR - 10) > 0.05 || L.arcDeg !== 90 ? 'arc text drag gave arcR ' + L.arcR + ', arcDeg ' + L.arcDeg + '; want 10, 90' : L.dx !== 0 || L.dy !== 0 ? 'arc text drag wrote dx, dy' : null; })()

(() => { const L = H.L('ring'), w = H.s.a.r1 - H.s.a.r0; return Math.abs(L.r1 - L.r0 - w) > 1e-9 ? 'ring width changed' : Math.abs((L.r0 + L.r1) / 2 - 12) > 0.05 ? 'ring centre radius ' + (L.r0 + L.r1) / 2 + ', want 12' : null; })()
H.st().raster && H.st().raster.mode === 'exact' ? null : 'no exact print raster after a build'
(() => { const r = H.st().raster; return r && r.mode === 'preview' && r.res === 4 ? null : 'dragging shows ' + JSON.stringify(r) + ', want the 4 px/mm preview'; })()
H.st().raster && H.st().raster.mode === 'exact' ? null : 'release did not return to the exact raster'
(() => { const e = ARTBOARD.events().map((x) => x.type); return ['select', 'touch', 'commit', 'focusText'].filter((t) => !e.includes(t)).map((t) => 'no ' + t + ' event').join(', ') || null; })()
H.st().sel === 'text' ? null : 'tap selected ' + H.st().sel
H.L('text').dx === H.s.a.dx && H.L('text').dy === H.s.a.dy ? 'touch drag did not move the layer' : null
H.L('text').rot === 90 ? null : 'touch rotate to 93 degrees committed ' + H.L('text').rot
H.L('text').size > H.s.a.size ? null : 'touch scale did nothing'
H.types.has('touch') && !H.types.has('mouse') ? null : 'pointer types seen: ' + [...H.types].join(', ')
